findings.title_text: Remuneration to working partners: the s.40(b)(v) limit depends on book profit, not computed here
limits_text: The s.40(b)(v) remuneration ceiling is a slab on 'book profit' (s.28-44D profit plus remuneration debited, per Explanation 3), which this test does not compute; whether remuneration is authorised and quantified by the deed, and from what date, is a deed reading, not a books fact.

The s.40(b)(v) ceiling (s.40(b)(v) as amended by the Finance (No. 2) Act 2024, from AY 2025-26): on the first ₹6 lakh of book profit (or a loss), ₹3 lakh or 90% of the book profit, whichever is more; on the balance, 60%. It applies to the firm's book profit, which this test does not compute, so no limit is stated here.
ask_client_text: Provide the computation of book profit under s.40(b) Explanation 3, and the deed clause authorising and quantifying remuneration.

findings.title_text: s.40(b) not computed for partner (tag 177f4125): this test computes the excess for no partner; the CA computes it
limits_text: This test computes the s.40(b) excess for no partner: its reading of a partner's interest from the books can miss or misread some bookings (another partner's interest or remuneration ledger crediting this partner's capital, or a ledger configured in two roles), so no excess it computed would be safe to list in clause 21(c). The CA computes the excess from the deed, the capital accounts and the interest credited. What this test could see is named below, and the interest credited and allowable-interest figures are working figures only.

The deed authorises no interest on capital (as recorded in the configuration), so s.40(b) allows none: interest paid or credited to this partner, through any ledger (its remuneration ledger included), is disallowed in full. This test does not search the books for such interest, beyond reading its configured interest ledger as a working figure (marked not usable), and states no disallowed amount.
No s.40(b) excess is stated for this partner, and none is listed in clause 21(c). Its interest credited and allowable-interest figures are marked not usable for s.40(b).
